questions.question: What is the average amount of interest per year which the company had to pay during this period?
questions.hindiQuestion: इस अवधि के दौरान कंपनी को प्रति वर्ष ब्याज की औसत कितनी राशि चुकानी पड़ी?
questions.explanation: Sum of Interest on Loans = 13.4 + 22.5 + 31.6 + 26.4 + 39.4 = ₹133.3 lakhs. Average per year over 5 years = 133.3 / 5 = ₹26.66 lakhs.

questions.question: The total bonus paid by the company during the period is approximately what percent of the total salary paid?
questions.hindiQuestion: दी गई अवधि के दौरान कंपनी द्वारा भुगतान किया गया कुल बोनस, कुल वेतन का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत है?

questions.question: Total expenditure on all listed items in 2011 was approximately what percent of total expenditure in 2015?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2011 में सभी मदों पर कुल व्यय, 2015 के कुल व्यय का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत था?

questions.question: What was the total expenditure on these items in 2013?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2013 में इन मदों पर कुल कितना व्यय हुआ?

questions.question: The ratio of total expenditure on Taxes for all years to total expenditure on Fuel and Transport is approximately what?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी वर्षों के लिए करों (Taxes) पर कुल व्यय और ईंधन तथा परिवहन पर कुल व्यय का अनुपात लगभग क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total Taxes = 85 + 110 + 75 + 78 + 88 = 436 lakhs. Total Fuel & Transport = 100 + 112 + 105 + 135 + 152 = 604 lakhs. Ratio = 436 / 604 = 109 / 151.

questions.question: What was the ratio of the average speed of Alto and Tiago during the 10 days?
questions.hindiQuestion: 10 दिनों के दौरान ऑल्टो (Alto) और टियागो (Tiago) की औसत गति का अनुपात क्या था?
questions.explanation: Distance covered by Alto in 10 days = 10 days × 10 L/day × 25 km/L = 2500 km. Speed of Alto = 2500 / 50 = 50 km/h. Distance covered by Tiago = 10 × 12 × 30 = 3600 km. Speed of Tiago = 3600 / 50 = 72 km/h. Ratio = 50 : 72 = 25 : 36.
questions.tableData:
| Car | Mileage (km/litre) | Avg. diesel used per day (litres) | Total time to cover the distance travelled in 10 days (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alto | 25 | 10 | 50 |
| Swift | 22 | 10 | 55 |
| Tiago | 30 | 12 | 50 |
| Mini | 20 | 25 | 80 |
| Kwid | 25 | 20 | 100 |

questions.question: Alto and Kwid travel towards each other at their average speeds during the 10 days. If the starting distance is 2,300 km, what is the difference between the times each takes to reach the other's starting point after meeting?
questions.hindiQuestion: ऑल्टो और क्विड 10 दिनों की अपनी औसत गति से एक-दूसरे की ओर यात्रा करते हैं। यदि प्रारंभिक दूरी 2,300 किमी है, तो मिलने के बाद एक-दूसरे के शुरुआती बिंदु तक पहुँचने में दोनों द्वारा लिए गए समय का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Speed of Alto = (10 × 10 × 25) / 50 = 50 km/h. Distance covered by Kwid = 10 × 20 × 25 = 5000 km, speed = 5000 / 100 = 50 km/h. Since both cars travel at exactly the same speed (50 km/h), each takes identical time to cover the remaining distance after meeting. Difference = 0 hours.

|---|---|---|---|
| Alto | 25 | 10 | 50 |
| Swift | 22 | 10 | 55 |
| Tiago | 30 | 12 | 50 |
| Mini | 20 | 25 | 80 |
| Kwid | 25 | 20 | 100 |

questions.question: Find the ratio of the time Mini takes to travel 875 km to the time Swift takes to travel 990 km, using their average speeds during the 10 days.
questions.hindiQuestion: 10 दिनों के दौरान उनकी औसत गति का उपयोग करके, मिनी द्वारा 875 किमी की यात्रा करने में लिए गए समय और स्विफ्ट द्वारा 990 किमी की यात्रा करने में लिए गए समय का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Mini distance in 10 days = 10 × 25 × 20 = 5000 km. Speed of Mini = 5000 / 80 = 62.5 km/h. Time for 875 km = 875 / 62.5 = 14 hours. Swift distance in 10 days = 10 × 10 × 22 = 2200 km. Speed of Swift = 2200 / 55 = 40 km/h. Time for 990 km = 990 / 40 = 24.75 hours = 99/4 hours. Ratio = 14 / (99/4) = 56 : 99.

questions.question: If the total distance covered by all cars in 10 days is covered by car A in 150 hours and car B in 300 hours, what is the difference between their average speeds?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि सभी कारों द्वारा 10 दिनों में तय की गई कुल दूरी को कार A द्वारा 150 घंटे में और कार B द्वारा 300 घंटे में तय किया जाता है, तो उनकी औसत गति के बीच क्या अंतर है?
questions.explanation: Total distance by all 5 cars in 10 days = Alto (2500) + Swift (2200) + Tiago (3600) + Mini (5000) + Kwid (5000) = 18,300 km. Speed of Car A = 18300 / 150 = 122 km/h. Speed of Car B = 18300 / 300 = 61 km/h. Difference = 122 − 61 = 61 km/h.

|---|---|---|---|

questions.question: What was the ratio of the total distance covered by Tiago to the total distance covered by Mini during the 10 days?
questions.hindiQuestion: 10 दिनों के दौरान टियागो द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी और मिनी द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी का अनुपात क्या था?
questions.explanation: Total distance Tiago = 10 × 12 × 30 = 3600 km. Total distance Mini = 10 × 25 × 20 = 5000 km. Ratio = 3600 / 5000 = 36 / 50 = 18 : 25.

questions.question: For which district was the average number of candidates selected over the years minimum?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी वर्षों में चयनित उम्मीदवारों की औसत संख्या किस जिले के लिए न्यूनतम थी?

questions.question: For District D, in which year was the percentage of qualified candidates among those who appeared lowest?
questions.hindiQuestion: जिला D के लिए, किस वर्ष में उपस्थित होने वालों में से योग्य (qualified) उम्मीदवारों का प्रतिशत सबसे कम था?

questions.question: In 2011, which district had the highest percentage of selected candidates among those who appeared?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2011 में, उपस्थित होने वालों में से चयनित उम्मीदवारों का उच्चतम प्रतिशत किस जिले में था?

questions.question: The number selected from District E during the period was approximately what percent of the number selected from District A?
questions.hindiQuestion: इस अवधि के दौरान जिला E से चयनित उम्मीदवारों की संख्या, जिला A से चयनित उम्मीदवारों की संख्या का लगभग कितना प्रतिशत थी?
questions.explanation: Selected E = 340. Selected A = 384. Percentage = (340 / 384) × 100 = 88.54%.

questions.question: In which year was the percentage of candidates selected among those qualified from District C highest?
questions.hindiQuestion: जिला C से योग्य (qualified) उम्मीदवारों में से चयनित उम्मीदवारों का प्रतिशत किस वर्ष में सबसे अधिक था?

questions.question: By approximately what percent did Company S's product sales increase from January to April?
questions.hindiQuestion: जनवरी से अप्रैल तक कंपनी S की उत्पाद बिक्री में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई?
questions.explanation: Company S sales in Jan = 85. In April = 140. Increase = 140 − 85 = 55. % increase = (55 / 85) × 100 ≈ 64.71%.

questions.question: Of Company T's products sold in March, April and May together, 32% were mild-steel products. How many mild-steel products were sold?
questions.hindiQuestion: मार्च, अप्रैल और मई में मिलाकर कंपनी T द्वारा बेचे गए उत्पादों में से 32% माइल्ड-स्टील उत्पाद थे। कितने माइल्ड-स्टील उत्पाद बेचे गए?
questions.explanation: Total sales by T in Mar + Apr + May = 120 + 165 + 165 = 450 units. Mild-steel products = 32% of 450 = 0.32 × 450 = 144.

questions.question: What was the approximate average number of products sold by Companies P, S and T in February?
questions.hindiQuestion: फरवरी में कंपनी P, S और T द्वारा बेचे गए उत्पादों की अनुमानित औसत संख्या क्या थी?

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total products sold by Companies P and R in March to the total sold by the same companies in April?
questions.hindiQuestion: मार्च में कंपनी P और R द्वारा बेचे गए कुल उत्पादों का अप्रैल में उन्हीं कंपनियों द्वारा बेचे गए कुल उत्पादों से अनुपात क्या है?

questions.question: What is the difference between the combined sales of Company Q in January and May and Company R in those same months?
questions.hindiQuestion: जनवरी और मई में कंपनी Q की संयुक्त बिक्री और उन्हीं महीनों में कंपनी R की संयुक्त बिक्री के बीच का अंतर क्या है?
questions.explanation: Company Q in Jan + May = 80 + 120 = 200. Company R in Jan + May = 155 + 130 = 285. Difference = 285 − 200 = 85.

questions.question: If 60% of Company E's account employees and 40% of its research employees have MBA degrees, how many employees of Company E have MBA degrees?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि कंपनी E के लेखा (account) कर्मचारियों में से 60% और अनुसंधान (research) कर्मचारियों में से 40% के पास MBA की डिग्री है, तो कंपनी E के कितने कर्मचारियों के पास MBA की डिग्री है?
questions.explanation: Company E Total = 350. Account employees % = 12% + 18% = 30% => 0.30 × 350 = 105. 60% of 105 = 63. Research employees % = 3% + 7% = 10% => 0.10 × 350 = 35. 40% of 35 = 14. Total MBA holders = 63 + 14 = 77.

questions.question: What is the ratio of female account employees in Company B to male research employees in Company C?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी B में महिला लेखा कर्मचारियों और कंपनी C में पुरुष अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Female account employees in B = 10% of 700 = 70. Male research employees in C = 4% of 550 = 22. Ratio = 70 : 22 = 35 : 11.

questions.question: The number of account employees in Company A is approximately what percent more than the number of research employees in Company E?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी A में लेखा कर्मचारियों की संख्या, कंपनी E में अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों की संख्या से लगभग कितने प्रतिशत अधिक है?
questions.explanation: Account employees in A = 26% of 450 = 117. Research employees in E = 10% of 350 = 35. Difference = 117 − 35 = 82. % more = (82 / 35) × 100 ≈ 234.29%.

questions.question: What is the ratio of male account employees in Companies A and C together to female research employees in Companies B and D together?
questions.hindiQuestion: कंपनी A और C में मिलाकर पुरुष लेखा कर्मचारियों का कंपनी B और D में मिलाकर महिला अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों से अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Male account in A & C = 54 + 154 = 208. Female research in B & D = 91 + 24 = 115. Ratio = 208 : 115.

questions.question: What is the difference between female account employees in all companies except D and male research employees in all companies except A and E?
questions.hindiQuestion: D को छोड़कर सभी कंपनियों में महिला लेखा कर्मचारियों और A तथा E को छोड़कर सभी कंपनियों में पुरुष अनुसंधान कर्मचारियों के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

questions.question: If the male population above the poverty line in State C is 1.5 million, what is State C's total population?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की जनसंख्या 1.5 मिलियन है, तो राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: In State C, % above poverty line = 75%. Ratio of M : F above poverty line = 2 : 3. Male fraction = 2/5 of 75% = 30% of total population. If 30% = 1.5 million, Total population = 1.5 / 0.30 = 5 million.

questions.question: What is the number of females above the poverty line in State D if its population is 7 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य D की जनसंख्या 7 मिलियन है, तो राज्य D में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Population above poverty line in State D = 80% of 7 million = 5.6 million. Female fraction = 3 / (4 + 3) = 3/7. Females above poverty line = (3/7) × 5.6 = 2.4 million.

questions.question: What is the approximate male population above the poverty line in State A if the female population below the poverty line is 1.8 million?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे महिलाओं की जनसंख्या 1.8 मिलियन है, तो राज्य A में गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर पुरुषों की अनुमानित जनसंख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Females below poverty line in A = 6/11 of Below-poverty population = 1.8 M => Below-poverty population = 1.8 × 11 / 6 = 3.3 million. Since below poverty line is 30%, Total population = 3.3 / 0.30 = 11 million. Population above poverty line (70%) = 7.7 million. Males above = 6/13 × 7.7 million ≈ 3.5538 million ≈ 3.55 million.
questions.verificationNote: Stem corrected: The original question printed 'above' the poverty line where 'below' was required to match the calculation: Female below = 1.8M => Total = 11M => Male above = 7.7 × 6/13 ≈ 3.55 M.

questions.question: If males below the poverty line number 2.4 million in State B and 6 million in State E, what is the ratio of the total populations of States B and E?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य B में गरीबी रेखा से नीचे पुरुषों की संख्या 2.4 मिलियन है और राज्य E में 6 मिलियन है, तो राज्य B और E की कुल जनसंख्या का अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: In B: Males below = (3/8) × 0.20 × Pop(B) = 0.075 Pop(B) = 2.4 M => Pop(B) = 2.4 / 0.075 = 32 million. In E: Males below = (5/8) × 0.15 × Pop(E) = 0.09375 Pop(E) = 6 M => Pop(E) = 6 / 0.09375 = 64 million. Ratio Pop(B) : Pop(E) = 32 : 64 = 1 : 2.

questions.question: If State C has a total population of 4 million, how many females are above the poverty line?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि राज्य C की कुल जनसंख्या 4 मिलियन है, तो गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर महिलाओं की संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Population above poverty line in State C = 75% of 4 million = 3 million. Female share = 3 / (2 + 3) = 3/5. Number of females = (3/5) × 3 million = 1.8 million.

questions.question: What are the approximate average marks obtained by all seven students in English?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी सात छात्रों द्वारा अंग्रेजी (अधिकतम 120) में प्राप्त अनुमानित औसत अंक क्या हैं?
questions.explanation: English max marks = 120. Percentages: 50, 85, 70, 65, 90, 80, 80. Sum of percentages = 520%. Average percentage = 520 / 7 ≈ 74.285%. Average marks = 74.285% of 120 = 89.14 ≈ 89.

questions.question: How many students obtained 60% and above marks in all subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: कितने छात्रों ने सभी विषयों में 60% और उससे अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए?
questions.explanation: Inspecting each student's percentages: Ankit has Maths 35% (<60%); Brijesh has Hindi 50% (<60%); Chirag: 90, 60, 70, 70, 90, 70 (all >= 60%); Divyesh has Hindi 40% (<60%); Ehan has Maths 50% (<60%); Faruk has Biology 40% (<60%); Gautam: 80, 65, 80, 80, 60, 60 (all >= 60%). Exactly 2 students (Chirag and Gautam) scored >= 60% in all subjects.

questions.question: What were Ehan's aggregate marks in all six subjects?
questions.hindiQuestion: सभी छह विषयों में एहान (Ehan) के कुल प्राप्तांक कितने थे?

questions.question: In which subject is the overall percentage lowest?
questions.hindiQuestion: किस विषय में समग्र (overall) प्रतिशत सबसे कम है?
questions.explanation: Sum of percentages across the 7 students: Maths has the lowest sum (35 + 65 + 60 + 75 + 50 + 80 + 65 = 430%), making its overall average percentage lowest among the choices.

questions.question: What is Brijesh's approximate overall percentage?
questions.hindiQuestion: बृजेश का अनुमानित समग्र प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.explanation: Total marks scored by Brijesh = 120 + 84.5 + 102 + 95 + 30 + 36 = 467.5. Total maximum marks = 150 + 130 + 120 + 100 + 60 + 40 = 600. Overall percentage = (467.5 / 600) × 100 ≈ 77.92% ≈ 78%.

questions.question: Which type of car manufactured by company X during 2016–2021 had the maximum production?

questions.question: What was the approximate percentage increase in production of car A from 2016 to 2021?

questions.question: The ratio of discount percentage on book C in store 1 and store 2 is 3 : 2. If the selling price in store 1 is ₹220, what is the approximate selling price in store 2?
questions.hindiQuestion: दुकान 1 और दुकान 2 में पुस्तक C पर छूट प्रतिशत का अनुपात 3 : 2 है। यदि दुकान 1 में विक्रय मूल्य ₹220 है, तो दुकान 2 में अनुमानित विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
questions.explanation: Since discount in Store 1 = 12%, and ratio is 3:2, discount in Store 2 = (2/3) × 12% = 8%. SP1 = 0.88 MP = 220 => MP = 220 / 0.88 = ₹250. SP2 = 0.92 × 250 = ₹230.

questions.question: The amounts paid by family X on the phone, electricity and water bills in June were 12%, 16% and 25% higher than in May. Find the total amount paid by family X on all three bills in June.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the total amount paid on phone bills to that on electricity bills over the five months by the family that paid the highest electricity bill in January?
questions.hindiQuestion: जनवरी में सबसे अधिक बिजली बिल का भुगतान करने वाले परिवार द्वारा पांच महीनों में फोन बिलों पर भुगतान की गई कुल राशि का बिजली बिलों से अनुपात क्या है?
questions.explanation: Highest electricity in Jan was Family Z (₹2500). Total Phone bills for Z = 1500 + 1350 + 1200 + 1250 + 1400 = ₹6,700. Total Electricity bills for Z = 2500 + 1400 + 2400 + 1250 + 1150 = ₹8,700. Ratio = 6700 : 8700 = 67 : 87 = 335 : 435.

questions.explanation: Total Phone Y = 6150. Total Electricity Y = 5500. Excess = 6150 − 5500 = 650. % more = (650 / 5500) × 100 = 11.818% ≈ 12%.

questions.question: What is the average consumption of crude oil in each of the five countries in 2020?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2020 में पाँचों देशों में से प्रत्येक में कच्चे तेल की औसत खपत (Consumption) क्या थी? (खपत = उत्पादन + आयात − निर्यात)
questions.explanation: Consumption in 2020 = Production + Import − Export: Afghanistan = 2100 + 400 − 600 = 1900. Bangladesh = 1400 + 300 − 400 = 1300. Bhutan = 2000 + 400 − 800 = 1600. India = 2200 + 500 − 600 = 2100. Maldives = 700 + 1300 − 500 = 1500. Total Consumption = 1900 + 1300 + 1600 + 2100 + 1500 = 8400. Average = 8400 / 5 = 1680.

questions.question: In 2022, which country’s import to consumption ratio was the highest among the following countries?

questions.explanation: In 2022, Maldives has Import = 1586 and Consumption = 1829. Ratio = 1586 / 1829 ≈ 0.867 (86.7%), which is far higher than any other country.

questions.question: The percentage increase in crude oil consumption from 2020 to 2022 is the highest for which of the following countries?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2020 से 2022 तक कच्चे तेल की खपत में प्रतिशत वृद्धि निम्नलिखित में से किस देश के लिए सबसे अधिक है?
questions.explanation: Consumption growth: Bangladesh = (1620 − 1300)/1300 = 320/1300 ≈ 24.615%; Bhutan = (1980 − 1600)/1600 = 380/1600 = 23.75%; Maldives = (1829 − 1500)/1500 = 329/1500 = 21.93%; Afghanistan = (2302 − 1900)/1900 = 402/1900 = 21.16%. Bangladesh has the highest percentage increase.

questions.question: Suppose A, B and C mix their solutions in one vessel. What would be the concentration of milk in the new solution? (approximately)
questions.hindiQuestion: मान लीजिए A, B और C अपने घोल को एक बर्तन में मिलाते हैं। नए घोल में दूध की सांद्रता लगभग क्या होगी?
questions.explanation: Total milk sold = 2000 litres. A gets 20% = 400 L pure milk; with 20% water concentration, milk concentration = 80%, so total solution = 400/0.8 = 500 L (water = 100 L). B gets 10% = 200 L pure milk; with 10% water, solution = 200/0.9 = 222.22 L (water = 22.22 L). C gets 10% = 200 L pure milk; with 15% water, solution = 200/0.85 = 235.29 L (water = 35.29 L). Total pure milk = 400 + 200 + 200 = 800 L. Total solution = 500 + 222.22 + 235.29 = 957.51 L. Concentration of milk = (800 / 957.51) × 100 ≈ 83.55%.

question.en: What is the difference between number of male from town E who have voted and female from town B who have voted?
question.hi: शहर E से मतदान करने वाले पुरुषों और शहर B से मतदान करने वाली महिलाओं की संख्या के बीच क्या अंतर है?

explanation.en: Voted in E = 94% of 32500 = 30550. Male voted in E = 60% of 30550 = 18330. Female voted in B = 45% of 10800 = 4860. Difference = 18330 − 4860 = 13470.
